notes: Completed personal source-only reading of all50 original blinded reports and explicit reasoning for all12 targets per report under frozen protocol, in five ten-report chunks. No025 draft/review, legacy annotations, gold target values, regex/NLI inference, or default-filling process used. Scripts only assemble already reasoned decisions and validate exact contiguous quotes/schema/UID coverage. Every nonmissing state has an exact original-language source span; silence remains not_mentioned. Source uncertainty, threshold decisions, history, and limitations are in each row and flagged below. This draft requires a separate independent source reviewer; extraction consistency is not diagnostic image accuracy.
